items.raw_excerpt: Medieval life is violent and the diet is spare, but the absence of doomscrolling makes it more than worthwhile, live-action role-players say.
items.summary_en: A group of people in Australia dress up and act as people from medieval times. They say this hobby helps them escape social media and meet real friends. The simple food and rough life do not stop them from having fun.
items.summary_ko: 호주의 한 사람들이 중세 사람처럼 옷을 입고 역할을 하며 논다. 이들은 이런 취미가 소셜 미디어에서 벗어나 진짜 친구를 만나게 해 준다고 말한다. 소박한 음식과 거친 생활도 이들의 즐거움을 막지 못한다.
items.title_en: LARP players leave their phones to live in the past
items.title_ko: 라프 참가자들은 휴대폰을 내려놓고 중세를 산다
items.title_original: The LARPers escaping algorithims and finding real life in the past

items.raw_excerpt: A Vietnamese high school student and his friends have developed an AI system that can decipher doctors' handwriting and digitize medical records, with Amazon providing US$35,000 to support its further development.
items.summary_en: A high school student in Vietnam built an AI system that reads doctors' messy handwriting and turns medical records into digital text. Amazon gave his team US$35,000 to help them develop it further.
items.summary_ko: 베트남의 한 고등학생이 친구들과 함께 의사의 알아보기 힘든 손글씨를 읽어 의료 기록을 디지털로 바꿔 주는 인공지능을 만들었습니다. 아마존은 이 시스템을 더 발전시키라며 3만 5천 달러를 지원했습니다.
items.title_en: Vietnamese student uses AI to read doctors' handwriting and wins Amazon funding
items.title_ko: 베트남 고등학생, 의사 손글씨 읽는 인공지능 개발해 아마존 지원금 받아
items.title_original: Vietnamese student uses AI to digitize doctors' cryptic handwriting, wins Amazon funding

items.raw_excerpt: Teachers will have their administrative workload reduced and get a checklist for supporting children with diverse learning needs.
items.summary_en: A Singapore preschool group will double its spending on staff development to S$20 million over three years. Teachers will get less paperwork and a checklist to help children with different learning needs.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르의 한 유치원 운영 단체가 3년 동안 교직원 교육에 쓰는 예산을 2000만 싱가포르달러로 두 배 늘린다. 교사들은 행정 업무를 줄이고, 다양한 학습 요구가 있는 아이들을 돕는 점검표를 받게 된다.
items.title_en: PCF Sparkletots to double staff training budget to S$20 million

items.raw_excerpt: Long-term residents of Villa Las Estrellas, a Chilean settlement on Antarctica's King George Island, must have their appendix removed before moving in because the nearest major hospital is more than 1,000 km away.
items.summary_en: Villa Las Estrellas is a small Chilean settlement on King George Island in Antarctica. Before moving in, every long-term resident must have their appendix removed. The nearest major hospital is over 1,000 km away, so there is no time for emergency surgery.
items.summary_ko: 빌라 라스 에스트레야스는 남극 킹조지섬에 있는 작은 칠레 정착촌이다. 이곳에 오래 살려면 들어오기 전에 모두 맹장을 떼어 내야 한다. 가장 가까운 큰 병원이 1,000킬로미터 넘게 떨어져 있어 응급 수술을 받을 시간이 없기 때문이다.
items.title_en: Antarctic village requires all residents to have their appendix removed

items.raw_excerpt: The initial expropriations for the high-speed rail line between Porto and Lisbon are advancing in the Aveiro district, affecting more than 1,000 land parcels across three municipalities along a 15.5-kilometre stretch of the A1.
items.summary_en: A new high-speed rail line between Porto and Lisbon is moving forward in Portugal. The project is taking more than 1,000 land plots in the Aveiro area. The plots sit along a 15.5-kilometre stretch of the A1 road.
items.summary_ko: 포르투와 리스본을 잇는 고속철도 사업이 포르투갈에서 진행 중이다. 아베이루 지역에서 1000개가 넘는 토지 필지가 수용 대상이 된다. 이 필지들은 A1 도로 15.5킬로미터 구간을 따라 자리 잡고 있다.
items.title_en: High-speed rail line takes land in Portugal

items.raw_excerpt: There are some Dutch words which all foreigners in the Netherlands seem to adopt as soon as they get off the plane, train or ferry. So here’s a list of some of them. Lesson 63: First words Lekker: means tasty and is the first Dutch word everyone learns. Lekker describes just about everything which is positive: from a lekker broodje with lekker weer and lekkere sex. Borrel: For some reason, we don’t go for drinks; we always have a borrel....
items.summary_en: A Dutch news column lists ten words that newcomers in the Netherlands quickly learn. It covers everyday favorites like lekker for anything tasty or good, and borrel for casual drinks with friends.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드에 새로 온 사람들이 금방 익히는 네덜란드어 열 단어를 소개한 칼럼이다. 맛있거나 좋은 것을 뜻하는 레커, 친구와 가볍게 마시는 술자리를 뜻하는 보렐 같은 일상 단어를 다룬다.
items.title_en: 10 Dutch words every foreigner in the Netherlands picks up
items.title_ko: 네덜란드에 온 외국인이 바로 배우는 네덜란드어 열 단어

items.raw_excerpt: “Where else can you get such a broad sheet of events and the original ‘Pop-Up Shop’? We have it all!”
items.summary_en: Members say they get great value from the many events on offer. One highlight is the original Pop-Up Shop. They say the wide range of activities makes their membership worth it.

items.raw_excerpt: Cider Days will take place on Saturday, Oct. 10, from 10 a.m. – 4 p.m., and Oct. 11, from 12-4 p.m., on the Belmont Green.
items.summary_en: Mount Holly holds its Cider Days on the Belmont Village Green. It runs Saturday, Oct. 10 from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. and Sunday, Oct. 11 from 12 to 4 p.m. It is a small local fall event for the whole town.

items.raw_excerpt: My mum still lives in the village where I grew up and although I visit her regularly, I don’t often get the chance to leisurely wander around, to take the time revisit the places and spaces that I use...
items.summary_en: A writer grew up in a small village in North Yorkshire. His mother still lives there, so he visits often. On this trip, he walks slowly and looks again at the places he loved as a child.

items.title_en: A writer goes back to the North Yorkshire village of his childhood
